selector.rationale: Hepatic Adenoma best explains the presence of hypervascular liver lesions with histologically proven adenoma without malignancy and is supported by multiple evidence notes.

rejected.label: Hemorrhage
rejected.why: While hemorrhage is present, it is a symptom rather than the underlying diagnosis.

rejected.label: Nodular Regenerative Hyperplasia
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence and lower score compared to Hepatic Adenoma.

rejected.label: Focal Nodular Hyperplasia
rejected.why: Similar to Nodular Regenerative Hyperplasia, lack of strong evidence and lower score.

rejected.label: Hepatocellular Adenoma
rejected.why: Although similar to the champion, Hepatic Adenoma has a higher score and more comprehensive evidence support.
